name: Task List

screen_dependencies.reason: Edit Task action redirects to the Task Form screen for editing task details
Buka Group Lain action navigates via sidebar, relies on group list data

implementation_notes: SERVER-RENDERED ROUTES: (1) GET /groups/:group_id -> TaskController#index, (2) POST /tasks/:task_id/toggle -> TaskController#toggle, (3) POST /groups/:group_id/tasks -> TaskController#store, (4) DELETE /tasks/:task_id -> TaskController#destroy

UC003 View Task List: Logic=(1)Validate group_id->400 if missing,(2)SELECT group by ID WHERE deleted_at IS NULL->404 GROUP_NOT_FOUND,(3)SELECT tasks WHERE group_id=X AND deleted_at IS NULL,(4)ORDER BY done ASC, due_date ASC NULLS LAST, title ASC,(5)Compute is_overdue:!done && due_date<today && due_date IS NOT NULL,(6)Calculate total task count,(7)Render Edge template. DataOps=group:SELECT,task:SELECT. EdgeCases=empty group->message, long title->CSS truncate, overdue->badge class. Rules=sort by due_date then title,done below pending,no due_date still shown,overdue visually distinct.

UC004 Toggle Task: Logic=(1)Validate task_id,(2)SELECT task WHERE deleted_at IS NULL->404 if missing,(3)Toggle done=!done,(4)UPDATE task SET done,(5)Redirect to /groups/{group_id}. DataOps=task:SELECT,task:UPDATE.

UC005 Create Task: Logic=(1)Validate title non-empty->422 VALIDATION_ERROR,(2)SELECT group by id WHERE deleted_at IS NULL->404,(3)INSERT task with title,description,due_date,group_id,done=false,(4)Redirect to /groups/:group_id. DataOps=group:SELECT,task:INSERT. EdgeCases=title too long->validation error. Rules=task must have title,task belongs to one group.

UC006 Delete Task: Logic=(1)Client confirm dialog,(2)SELECT task WHERE deleted_at IS NULL->404,(3)UPDATE task SET deleted_at=NOW(),(4)Redirect to /groups/{group_id}. DataOps=task:SELECT,task:UPDATE(soft-delete). EdgeCases=already deleted->404. Rules=delete requires confirmation.
Use AdonisJS Lucid softDelete trait on Task and Group models
Toggle uses POST for browser form compatibility
Delete uses client-side confirm() dialog before form submit
Flash messages via session.flash() for success/error feedback on redirects
Overdue computed in controller, passed to Edge template as boolean flag
Edge template: done tasks get strikethrough+green checkbox, overdue gets colored badge
Title truncation via Tailwind 'truncate' CSS class
